title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Parking - Parking
description: Parking for different types of vehicles, on-street or off-street, public or private (edintapar:Parking, subclass of edintinf:Facility). Collapses the source ontology's two concrete subclasses (OnStreetParking, OffStreetParking) into a single entity with a parkingType discriminator, since the source's own real example data never instantiates bare Parking directly and OnStreetParking's only distinguishing property (isPartOfZone) is small enough to keep as an always-optional field rather than a second entity type.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Parking'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

infrastructureType.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of edint-infraestructura's InfrastructureType controlled vocabulary. Inherited from Facility.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit (e.g. city district / 'Barrio') the parking belongs to. Inherited from Facility.

containsFacility.description: Relationship. Other Facility entities physically contained within this one. Inherited from Facility.

hasObservationPoint.description: Relationship. The ObservationPoint(s) associated with this parking, where access sensors are deployed (edint-infraestructura's ObservationPoint). Inherited from Facility; this is the ontology's own stated link between Parking and the Infrastructure ontology's sensor representation.

hasRegisteredOwner.description: Relationship. The Organization that is the registered owner of this parking (edint-infraestructura's Organization). Inherited from Facility.

openingHours.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/openingHours'. The general opening hours, e.g. 'Mo-Fr 09:00-21:00; Sa 09:00-15:00'. Inherited from Facility.

accessibility.description: Property. Accessibility of the parking. Inherited from Facility (added there in source ontology v0.2.1).

isCadastralProperty.description: Relationship. Reference to the corresponding CadastralProperty entity in the city registry. Inherited from Facility (added there in source ontology v0.2.1).

locatedInZone.description: Relationship. Reference to the RegulatedZone the parking is located in (edint-zona-regulatoria's RegulatedZone). Inherited from Facility (added there in source ontology v0.2.1).

parkingType.description: Property. Whether this is on-street parking (edintapar:OnStreetParking) or off-street parking (edintapar:OffStreetParking) -- the source ontology's only two concrete subclasses of Parking, collapsed into a single entity since bare 'Parking' is never directly instantiated in the source's own real example data. 'isPartOfZone' below only applies when this is 'OnStreet'.

isPartOfZone.description: Relationship. The RegulatedParkingZone this (on-street) parking belongs to (edintapar:isPartOfZone, edint-zona-regulatoria's RegulatedZone with zoneType=RegulatedParkingZone). Only declared on OnStreetParking in the source ontology; only meaningful when parkingType is 'OnStreet'.

hasParkingFee.description: Relationship. The ParkingFee that applies to this parking (edintapar:hasParkingFee).

hasParkingSpot.description: Relationship. The individual ParkingSpot(s) this parking contains (edintapar:hasParkingSpot).

hasSpotsByParkingPermitType.description: Relationship. Group(s) of parking spots by permit type, e.g. resident, rotation (edintapar:hasSpotsByParkingPermitType, ParkingSpotsByPermitType).

hasSpotsByVehicleType.description: Relationship. Group(s) of parking spots by vehicle type, e.g. cars, motorcycles (edintapar:hasSpotsByVehicleType, ParkingSpotsByVehicleType).

numberOfParkingSpots.description: Property. Total number of parking spots in this parking (edintapar:numberOfParkingSpots).
